nodes.text: Welcome to Hammerhead! She's been waitin' for ya, Prince. We got fuel, parts, and good cookin'.
What can I do for ya?

choices.label: Tell me about the road ahead.
I heard you need help with goblins.

nodes.text: Road to Lestallum's been rough lately. Goblins been harassin' travellers near the canyon. Watch yourselves out there.
Sure do. Pack of 'em been blockin' the road. Take out three of 'em and I'll owe ya a hot meal.
You need anything else, just holler. May the light guide ya, Prince.
